title: HtmlSummary
responsibility: Renders the native summary element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSummary.attributes
inputs.description: Native summary attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSummary.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native summary element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSummary
outputs.description: The actual native summary element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
